comparison.objective: Identify and fully reseat the one half-inserted network plug without disturbing three seated neighbors.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual fault finding and constrained plug insertion among adjacent cables.
comparison.success_condition: Loose plug reaches at least 22 mm depth, all neighbors remain seated, and the robot releases all plugs.
comparison.reason: Connector fault correction is explicitly a plug-insertion family and lacks the candidate's fine adjustment, lock retention, and stopping-response commissioning.
